single_variable_patch.limit: Update only the synthesized description EventPattern field, not scheduling predicates, turn semantics, mana/payment engine, card definition, Pact advisor, deck, or AI profile.

An actually matching delayed END trigger retains synthesized EventPattern.StepEvent(Step.END, Player.Each); UPKEEP probe does not fire.
A delayed trigger gated to one player cannot fire during another player's turn.
NEXT_TURN lower turn bound remains enforced.
